title: Mother, newborn missing in Cape Breton
summary: Police in Cape Breton are seeking public help to locate 37-year-old Clarissa Lynn Dennis and her newborn son who went missing in Groves Point on Sunday.

image.caption: 37-year-old Clarissa Lynn Dennis and her newborn son were lastly seen in Groves Point on Sunday, according to Cape Breton Regional Police. (Cape Breton Regional Police)

blocks.text: Police in Cape Breton are seeking public help to locate 37-year-old Clarissa Lynn Dennis and her newborn son who went missing in Groves Point on Sunday.
The two were last seen in Groves Point on Sunday afternoon
